column1: # Registry of claim sentences that wrap across source lines. Produced by the enumerator in
# status is EXERCISED:<test node id> | REGISTERED:<reason>; UNREVIEWED is capped at ZERO here,
# because nothing predates this layer: a wrapped sentence is read and ruled when it enters.
# A row keys the WHOLE wrapped sentence, so an edit to ANY of its source lines re-keys it --
# including a line that matches neither pattern on its own, which under the line layer alone
# could change a quantifier with no registry diff (the v1.2.0 disclosure this layer closes).
